comment.da:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Afstemningen om afgørelsen om decharge udgør afslutningen af regnskaberne (jf. bilag V, forretningsordenens artikel 5, stk. 1).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 1 blev annulleret.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 35 opfyldte ikke betingelserne for behandling.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Różne</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Głosowanie nad decyzją w sprawie absolutorium oznacza zamknięcie ksiąg (zob. załącznik V ust. 1 Regulaminu).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Poprawkę 1 anulowano.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Poprawka 35a została uznana za niedopuszczalną.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varji</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Il-votazzjoni dwar id-deċiżjoni dwar il-kwittanza tikkostitwixxi l-għeluq tal-kontijiet (ara l-Anness V, l-Artikolu 5(1), tar-Regoli ta’ Proċedura).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L-emenda 1 ġiet annullata.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L-emenda 35 ġiet iddikjarata inammissibbli.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>De stemming over het kwijtingsbesluit geldt tevens voor de afsluiting van de rekeningen (zie bijlage V, artikel 5, lid 1, van het Reglement).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 1 is geannuleerd.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 35 is niet-ontvankelijk verklaard.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Övrigt</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Omröstningen om beslutet att bevilja ansvarsfrihet omfattar avslutandet av räkenskaperna (se bilaga V, artikel 5.1 a i arbetsordningen).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 1a ströks.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 35a förklarades otillåtligt.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fi:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Muuta</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Äänestys vastuuvapauden myöntämistä koskevasta ehdotuksesta kattaa tilien päättämisen (työjärjestyksen liitteessä V olevan 5 artiklan 1 kohta).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Tarkistus 1 mitätöitiin.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Tarkistusta 35 ei otettu käsiteltäväksi.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Rôzne otázky</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Hlasovanie o rozhodnutí o absolutóriu znamená schválenie účtovnej závierky (pozri článok 5 odsek 1 prílohy V k rokovaciemu poriadku).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 1 bol zrušený.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 35 bol vyhlásený za neprípustný.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La aprobación de la Decisión sobre la aprobación de la gestión constituye el cierre de las cuentas (véase el anexo V, artículo 5, apartado 1, del Reglamento interno).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 1 ha sido anulada.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 35 ha sido declarada inadmisible.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.et:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Muud küsimused</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Hääletus eelarve täitmisele heakskiidu andmise otsuse üle tähendab raamatupidamiskontode sulgemist (vt kodukorra V lisa artikli 5 lõige 1).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Muudatusettepanek 1 tühistati.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Muudatusettepanek 35 tunnistati vastuvõetamatuks.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A mentesítési határozatról való szavazás az elszámolások lezárására vonatkozik (lásd az eljárási szabályzat V. melléklete 5. cikkének (1) bekezdését).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Az 1a. módosítást törölték.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>A 35a. módosítást elfogadhatatlannak nyilvánítják.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Glasovanje o odluci za davanje razrješnice znači i zaključenje poslovnih knjiga (vidjeti Prilog V. članak 5. stavak 1. Poslovnika)
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandman 1 je poništen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandman 35 proglašen je nedopuštenim.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Glasovanje o sklepu o podelitvi razrešnice pomeni tudi zaključek poslovnih knjig (glej Prilogo V, člen 5(1) Poslovnika).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 1 je bil razveljavljen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 35 je bil označen za nedopustnega.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Гласуването на решението за освобождаване от отговорност се счита за приключване на сметките (вж. приложение V, член 5, параграф 1 от Правилника за дейността).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 1 се анулира.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 35 беше обявено за недопустимо.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Balsavimas dėl sprendimo dėl biudžeto įvykdymo patvirtinimo laikomas sąskaitų uždarymu (žr. Darbo tvarkos taisyklių V priedo 5 straipsnio 1 dalį).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>1 pakeitimas buvo panaikintas.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>35 pakeitimas buvo paskelbtas nepriimtinu.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η ψηφοφορία επί της απόφασης απαλλαγής λογίζεται ως κλείσιμο των λογαριασμών (βλ. Παράρτημα V άρθρο 5 παράγραφος 1 του Κανονισμού).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 1 ακυρώνεται.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 35 κρίθηκε μη παραδεκτή.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A votação da decisão de quitação constitui decisão de encerramento das contas (ver anexo V, artigo 5.º, n.º 1, do Regimento).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 1 foi anulada.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 35 foi declarada não admissível.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Hlasování o rozhodnutí o udělení absolutoria je zároveň účetní závěrkou (viz příloha V čl. 5 odst. 1 jednacího řádu).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Pn. 1 byl zrušen.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Pn. 35 byl prohlášen za nepřípustný.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Aprobarea deciziei de descărcare de gestiune echivalează cu închiderea conturilor [a se vedea articolul 5 alineatul (1) din anexa V la Regulamentul de procedură].
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 1 a fost anulat.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 35 a fost declarat inadmisibil.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>The vote on the discharge decision constituted closure of the accounts (Annex V, Article 5(1) to the Rules of Procedure).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 1 had been cancelled.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 35 had been declared inadmissible.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ar balsojumu par lēmumu par budžeta izpildes apstiprināšanu ir apstiprināti arī pārskati (sk. Reglamenta V pielikuma 5. panta 1. punktu).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 1 bija atcelts.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 35 tika atzīts par nepieņemamu.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La votazione sulla decisione di discarico costituisce la chiusura dei conti (cfr. allegato V, articolo 5, paragrafo 1, del regolamento).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 1 è stato annullato.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 35 è stato dichiarato irricevibile.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Abstimmung über den Entlastungsbeschluss bedeutet gleichzeitig den Rechnungsabschluss (siehe Anlage V, Artikel 5 Absatz 1 GO).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 1 wurde annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 35 wurde für unzulässig erklärt.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Le vote sur la décision de décharge vaut clôture des comptes (voir annexe V, article 5, paragraphe 1, du règlement).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 1 a été annulé.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 35 a été déclaré irrecevable.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Is ionann an vótáil ar an gcinneadh maidir le hurscaoileadh a dheonú agus na cuntais a dhúnadh (féach Iarscríbhinn V, Airteagal 5(1) a ghabhann leis na Rialacha Nós Imeachta).
</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 1 a chealú.</translation></remarkFreeText><remarkFreeText><translation>Dearbhaíodh nach bhfuil Leasú 35 inghlactha.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
